common-ion-shift.alt: A bar chart of the molar solubility of PbCl2 at 25 °C: 1.6 × 10−2 M in pure water, falling to 1.3 × 10−2 M in 0.010 M NaCl, 4.8 × 10−3 M in 0.050 M NaCl and 2.7 × 10−4 M in 0.25 M NaCl. A side panel explains: Q = [Pb2+][Cl−] squared; added chloride raises Q above Ksp, so solid forms until Q = Ksp; Ksp is unchanged but the solubility is lower.
